items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Some of the other records you did for Prestige included one with Jerome Richardson, Ray Bryant, Wendell Marshall and Art Taylor.

ctx.x: that they didn't want, and all of a sudden... they don't consult me... I had to fight for the leadership fee, through I think it was Fox -- what's that company that gets your money back for you -- Fox. Some kind of Fox, I think it's Fox. Well, they help you get your royalties, you know, back. And it was finally switched around that I could, you know. They didn't even offer me that. They could say, 'well we would like to use this guy's name, put it here cause it sells more records, but you still get your fee' you…
Some of the other records you did for Prestige included one with Jerome Richardson, Ray Bryant, Wendell Marshall and Art Taylor.

Very fine players. They elected them I'll give them credit -- they elected everybody on there. Before I know anything, they say 'we got a session for you' -- Don Schlitten did the same thing for Muse Records. They selected the people...
